claims.claim: Local --no-leader help says start a new agent even when config enables leader mode.
Official ACP docs describe initialize, session/new, session/prompt, configOptions and reasoning_effort.
Agent definitions use Markdown YAML frontmatter; promptMode full, tools [], agentsMd false, permissionMode plan are documented.

Current official CLI source forwards permission mode, trust, updater and web-search options into run_agent_command, but not top-level max_turns or CLI tool allowlist. This source is not established as byte-identical to the installed binary.
The collector sends one ACP prompt and stops on tool/client-operation activity or total 300s deadline. It does not assert a native max-turns flag in agent mode.
